code='''def transform(grid):
    h=len(grid); w=len(grid[0])
    # The odd-colored cell identifies the corner of the L-shaped frame.
    from collections import Counter
    colors=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    frame=min(colors,key=colors.get)
    main=next(v for v in colors if v!=frame)
    corners=[(0,0),(0,w-1),(h-1,0),(h-1,w-1)]
    fr,fc=next((r,c) for r,c in corners if grid[r][c]==frame)
    out=[[8]*w for _ in range(h)]
    dr=1 if fr==0 else -1
    dc=1 if fc==0 else -1
    # Shift the two frame arms one cell into the rectangle.
    if fr==0:
        for c in range(w-1): out[1][c if fc==w-1 else c+1]=frame
    else:
        for c in range(w-1): out[h-2][c if fc==w-1 else c+1]=frame
    if fc==w-1:
        for r in range(h-1): out[r if fr==h-1 else r+1][w-2]=frame
    else:
        for r in range(h-1): out[r if fr==h-1 else r+1][1]=frame
    # Main-color diagonal from the far corner toward the shifted frame.
    r=h-1-fr; c=w-1-fc
    while 0<=r<h and 0<=c<w and out[r][c]==8:
        out[r][c]=main
        r+=dr; c+=dc
    return out
'''
